close_reason:
Added the defence-in-depth all-None /set guard across 11 /set methods in 7 extension-client crates: mail-client (4: email_set, mailbox_set, identity_set, email_submission_set), calendars-client (3: calendar_set, calendar_event_set, participant_identity_set), contacts-client (2: address_book_set, contact_card_set), filenode-client (1: file_node_set), metadata-client (1: metadata_set), sharing-client (1: principal_set), tasks-client (2: task_set, task_list_set). vacation_response_set (only takes update — Option), share_notification_set (destroy-only Vec), task_notification_set (destroy-only Vec) intentionally not modified — their signatures already preclude the all-None case.

Guard shape: top-of-function 'if create.is_none() && update.is_none() && destroy.is_none() { return Err(InvalidArgument("<method>: at least one of create, update, destroy must be Some (an all-None /set is a no-op round-trip)")); }'. Mirrors the existing pattern in email_import (empty emails map) and email_parse (empty blob_ids) cited by the bead.

Test impact: 7 pre-existing tests used 'all-None' as a convenient minimum input; all 7 updated to pass Some(empty_destroy) instead, preserving the actual test oracle (wire-shape assertions about field absence or extras propagation). Test integrity preserved per workspace AGENTS.md — oracles unchanged, inputs adjusted to satisfy the new precondition. Tests modified: calendar_set_on_destroy_remove_events_none_omits_field, mailbox_set_routes_vendor_extras_to_wire, mailbox_set_without_params_omits_on_destroy_remove_emails, email_submission_set_no_on_success_when_none, metadata_set_propagates_params_extras, metadata_set_params_extras_do_not_overwrite_account_id, task_list_set_without_on_destroy_omits_field.

Workspace canonical-template propagation: mail-client first, then propagated cookie-cutter to 6 sibling crates in the same pass.
title: /set methods accept create=None update=None destroy=None and generate wasted HTTP round-trip
